_curatorNotes: N1–N4 ActionCharge values are at InitNormalCancelSlice animation defaults (not explicitly set by gcsim author) and are omitted — reviewer may add if needed. N3 and N5 each have two hitmarks (N3: 19f+28f, N5: 26f+40f); last hitmark used as cancel-frame source per recipe. N5 has no explicit ActionAttack line so N is omitted (animation default=66). High plunge frames also modeled in gcsim but not represented here (recipe: use lowPlungeFrames). High plunge effective frames for reviewer reference: { swap: 67, N: 60, E: 60, Q: 60, D: 77 }.

abilities.name: Ravaging Confession
abilities.description:
Rosaria swiftly shifts her position to appear behind her opponent, then stabs and slashes them with her polearm, dealing Cryo DMG.
This ability cannot be used to travel behind opponents of a larger build.

abilities.name: Rites of Termination
abilities.description:
Rosaria's unique take on this prayer ritual: First, she swings her weapon to slash surrounding opponents; then, she summons a frigid Ice Lance that strikes the ground. Both actions deal Cryo DMG.
While active, the Ice Lance periodically releases a blast of cold air, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.

passives.name: Regina Probationum

_curatorNotes: Migrated to onHit ability:skill 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim uses a done=true guard so it fires once per E cast. The 'from behind' condition is assumed true (gcsim treats Rosaria as always attacking from behind unless explicitly disabled); not enforceable in the schema.

passives.description: When Rosaria strikes an opponent from behind using Ravaging Confession, Rosaria's CRIT Rate increases by 12% for 5s.

passives.name: Shadow Samaritan

value.description: +15% of Rosaria's CRIT Rate, capped at +15%

_curatorNotes: Migrated to onCast burst, target teamExcludingSelf 2026-05-09 (F1). Description says 'except Rosaria herself'; gcsim a4() skips Rosaria's index. Value form is unknown because the planner doesn't track Rosaria's runtime CR. Removed the erroneous self-target duplicate that the generator emitted.

passives.description:
Casting Rites of Termination increases CRIT Rate of all nearby party members (except Rosaria herself) by 15% of Rosaria's CRIT Rate for 10s.
CRIT Rate Bonus gained this way cannot exceed 15%.
